authorize.title: Authorize robomapper
authorize.description:
Run this command from a computer with SSH access to the robot, then select Submit:

```sh
{command}
```

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the robot address and SSH port.
error.authorization_required: Run the authorization command, then retry.
error.root_required: Robot SSH access must allow root.
error.host_key_changed: The robot's SSH identity changed. Remove and add the robot to reconnect.
error.key_failed: Could not create or read the SSH key. Check Home Assistant's configuration directory permissions.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Use the configured robot address, or add a new robot.
abort.save_running: Wait for the current save to finish before reconfiguring.
